turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail:
possible until a shipping label is created. After that, if a tracking number already exists, a FedEx address correction can be requested for a $17 flat fee, but FedEx does not guarantee the change. Once a package is out for delivery, the address cannot be changed.
A no-fee alternative documented in the help content is to ask FedEx to hold the package for pickup at a nearby location.
Details are here: https://onefastcat.com/pages/order-changes-shipping-address-changes
